message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  Roughly **48,000 soldiers** were killed, wounded, or taken prisoner in total:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French (and allied German contingents) | ~25 000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch‑Belgian‑Prussian coalition | ~23 000 |

These figures come from contemporary military reports and modern historical analyses.  The numbers vary slightly depending on the source, but most estimates place the total casualties in the mid‑40,000s.
